name: DLF AIM 3D Viewer
description: Drupal integration for the DLF AIM 3D Viewer JavaScript library (three.js) to display and convert 3D models on file fields.

suggests.wisski_core: Provides the wisski_individual entity used by the bundled savePreview/manifest route and WissKI repository integration.
suggests.image: Core Image module, used for image styles when generating and displaying model preview thumbnails.
suggests.colorbox: Optional; the viewer formatter references Colorbox/Image formatter base classes for gallery lightbox display.

project_description: DLF AIM 3D Viewer integrates the three.js-based DLF AIM 3D Viewer JavaScript library (installed separately to web/libraries/dlf_aim_3d_viewer/) into Drupal so 3D models attached to a core file field can be viewed interactively on entity displays. It was primarily built as a Drupal extension for a WissKI-based repository, but can also run standalone. Supported input formats include OBJ, DAE, FBX, PLY, IFC, STL, XYZ, JSON, 3DS and glTF, with a bundled server-side pipeline (bash + Python + Blender/IfcConvert utilities driven by a Drupal queue worker) that uncompresses archived uploads and converts a wide range of formats (obj, fbx, ply, dae, abc, blend, stl, wrl, x3d, glb, gltf) on-the-fly to GLB and renders thumbnail previews. The module ships a field formatter, a settings form and config object, a Drush configuration command, a queue worker with an entity-save-triggered background conversion runner, and several JSON/XML editor API endpoints (metadata save, thumbnail upload, METS/MODS XML export) used by the viewer's in-browser editor.
